classes.name: amortizing bond
classes.label: amortizing bond
classes.definition: bond that regularly pays down the principal (face value) on the debt along with its interest expense over the life of the bond

classes.name: bond
classes.label: bond
classes.definition: tradable debt instrument representing a loan in which the issuer owes the holder(s) a debt

classes.name: bond amortization payment terms
classes.label: bond amortization payment terms
classes.definition: terms that include a schedule for repayment of the principal over the lifetime of the bond, typically in equal payments at regular intervals

classes.name: bond conversion terms
classes.label: bond conversion terms
classes.definition: terms indicating when a convertible bond can be converted to another security (usually a publicly traded share issued by of the same issuer)

classes.name: bond coupon
classes.label: bond coupon
classes.definition: interest rate on a debt security that the issuer promises to pay to the holder until maturity, expressed as an annual percentage of the face value

classes.name: bond insurance
classes.label: bond insurance
classes.definition: insurance policy that a bond issuer purchases that guarantees the repayment of the principal and all associated interest payments to the bondholders in the event of default

classes.name: bond principal repayment terms
classes.label: bond principal repayment terms
classes.definition: terms for the repayment of the principal on a bond

classes.name: bond registrar
classes.label: bond registrar
classes.definition: party responsible for maintaining records on behalf of the issuer that identify the owners of a registered bond issue

classes.name: bond variable coupon
classes.label: bond variable coupon
classes.definition: bond coupon that has a variable interest rate

classes.name: bond with partial call
classes.label: bond with partial call
classes.definition: bond with a feature whereby the issue can be partially called for amounts that are at the discretion of the issuer

classes.name: bond with published sinking fund
classes.label: bond with published sinking fund
classes.definition: bond whereby amortization is via a known and published schedule

classes.name: bond with warrant
classes.label: bond with warrant
classes.definition: bond that is issued together with one or more warrant(s) attached as part of the offer, the warrant(s) granting the holder the right to purchase a designated security, often the common stock of the issuer of the debt, at a specified price

classes.name: Build America Bond
classes.label: Build America Bond
classes.definition: taxable municipal bond issued through December 31, 2010 under the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009 (ARRA)

classes.name: bullet bond
classes.label: bullet bond
classes.definition: bond whose entire principal value is paid on the maturity date, rather than amortized over its lifetime

classes.name: bond bullet principal repayment terms
classes.label: bond bullet principal repayment terms
classes.definition: terms for repayment of the principal for a bond as a single payment covering the whole principal amount

classes.name: callable bond
classes.label: callable bond
classes.definition: bond that includes a stipulation allowing the issuer the right to repurchase and retire the bond at the call price after the call protection period

classes.name: callable convertible bond
classes.label: callable convertible bond
classes.definition: convertible bond that is also callable

classes.name: certificate of obligation
classes.label: certificate of obligation
classes.definition: municipal security available to governing councils in case of emergency, such as a natural disaster, that needs immediate action without time for voter referendum

classes.name: certificate of participation
classes.label: certificate of participation
classes.definition: debt instrument evidencing a pro rata share in a specific pledged revenue stream, usually lease payments by the issuer that are typically subject to annual appropriation

classes.name: conventional gilt
classes.label: conventional gilt
classes.definition: fixed coupon bond issued by HM Treasury that guarantees to pay the holder of the gilt a fixed cash payment (coupon) every six months until the maturity date, at which point the holder receives the final coupon payment and the return of the principal

classes.name: convertible bond
classes.label: convertible bond
classes.definition: bond that gives the holder the right to convert the bond into a fixed number of shares (conversion ratio) if the equity price rises above a specified level (strike price)

classes.name: corporate bond
classes.label: corporate bond
classes.definition: bond issued by a company in order to raise financing

classes.name: coupon payment terms
classes.label: coupon payment terms
classes.definition: terms for payment of interest on a bond

classes.name: equity linked bond
classes.label: equity linked bond
classes.definition: bond based on the return on an equity over time, i.e. the price and dividend payments or the total return (similar to total return swaps)

classes.name: extraordinary redemption provision
classes.label: extraordinary redemption provision
classes.definition: provision that gives a bond issuer the right to call its bonds due to an unusual one-time occurrence, as specified in the offering statement

classes.name: first regular coupon date
classes.label: first regular coupon date
classes.definition: scheduled date for the first regular coupon payment, in a regular repeating series of coupon periods, after any non standard (long or short) first coupon period in the schedule

classes.name: fixed coupon bond
classes.label: fixed coupon bond
classes.definition: bond whose coupon rate and principal amount are fixed at the time of origination or sale and remain constant while the security is outstanding

classes.name: fixed coupon terms
classes.label: fixed coupon terms
classes.definition: terms for payment of interest on a bond with a fixed interest rate

classes.name: floating rate note
classes.label: floating rate note
classes.definition: bond with a variable interest rate based on a published reference interest rate

classes.name: full faith credit bond
classes.label: full faith credit bond
classes.definition: bond secured by an unconditional promise to pay by another entity

classes.name: general obligation municipal bond
classes.label: general obligation municipal bond
classes.definition: municipal bond that is backed by the full faith and credit and general resources of the issuing municipality, including its general taxing authority

classes.name: government bond
classes.label: government bond
classes.definition: debt security issued by a government to fund government spending

classes.name: government issued debt security
classes.label: government issued debt security
classes.definition: debt security issued by some government on behalf of some polity, including sovereign and municipal debt

classes.name: green bond
classes.label: green bond
classes.definition: bond issued specifically to fund climate or environmental projects

classes.name: implicit full faith credit bond
classes.label: implicit full faith credit bond
classes.definition: bond issued by a government sponsored agency or corporation rather than by the government directly

classes.name: index-linked bond
classes.label: index-linked bond
classes.definition: bond whose income may vary over time, because either the coupon rate or principal amount is related to a specific index, such as the Consumer Price Index

classes.name: inflation-linked bond
classes.label: inflation-linked bond
classes.definition: bond indexed to inflation so that the principal or interest payments rise and fall with the rate of inflation

classes.name: last regular coupon date
classes.label: last regular coupon date
classes.definition: scheduled date of the last regular coupon payment, that is the last of the payments that are made according to a regular repeating series of coupon periods, before any non-standard (long or short) final coupon period in the schedule

classes.name: listed bond
classes.label: listed bond
classes.definition: bond that may be traded on an exchange

classes.name: make whole call
classes.label: make whole call
classes.definition: call allowing the issuer to pay off remaining debt early

classes.name: mandatory convertible bond
classes.label: mandatory convertible bond
classes.definition: convertible bond that converts into shares at maturity regardless of the equity price

classes.name: medium term note
classes.label: medium term note
classes.definition: bond issued over time under a shelf registration program, where each issue may have a different coupon and maturity typically ranging from one to ten years

classes.name: municipal bond
classes.label: municipal bond
classes.definition: government bond that may be issued by a regional, rather than national, authority

classes.name: municipal debt funds usage
classes.label: municipal debt funds usage
classes.definition: official statement specifying how the funds raised via a new issue of municipal securities are to be applied

classes.name: municipal debt remarketing agent
classes.label: municipal debt remarketing agent
classes.definition: municipal securities dealer responsible for reselling to investors securities (such as variable rate demand obligations and other tender option bonds) that have been tendered for purchase by their owner

classes.name: municipal debt source of funds
classes.label: municipal debt source of funds
classes.definition: official statement identifying the source of funds for a new issue of municipal securities

classes.name: municipal note
classes.label: municipal note
classes.definition: short-term obligation to repay a specified principal amount on a certain date, together with interest at a stated rate, usually payable from a defined source of anticipated revenues

classes.name: municipal security
classes.label: municipal security
classes.definition: debt obligation issued by a regional governmental entity

classes.name: municipal trustee
classes.label: municipal trustee
classes.definition: financial institution with trust powers, designated by the issuer, that acts, pursuant to a bond contract, in a fiduciary capacity for the benefit of the bondholders in enforcing the terms of the bond contract

classes.name: original issue discount bond
classes.label: original issue discount bond
classes.definition: interest-bearing bond issued at a deep discount to face value

classes.name: partial call
classes.label: partial call
classes.definition: call of part of an issue

classes.name: partial call feature
classes.label: partial call feature
classes.definition: call feature whereby the issuer can recall part of the issue on scheduled dates, where bonds are selected to be called according to some rule, or by selecting various bonds at random

classes.name: partial redemption allocation convention
classes.label: partial redemption allocation convention
classes.definition: convention used to determine how the partial call will be actioned with respect to bond selection

classes.name: perpetual bond
classes.label: perpetual bond
classes.definition: bond that has no maturity date, i.e., one that pays interest in perpetuity

classes.name: rate basis convention
classes.label: rate basis convention
classes.definition: basis for a percentage quoted rate as used in specifying bond call percentage amounts

classes.name: redemption payment
classes.label: redemption payment
classes.definition: repayment event involving payment of a bond's principal amount at maturity or when it is called

classes.name: redemption schedule
classes.label: redemption schedule
classes.definition: repayment schedule whereby a given percentage of a bond issue is redeemed on predefined dates

classes.name: regulatory call
classes.label: regulatory call
classes.definition: call triggered by some regulation-specific rule

classes.name: remarketable bond
classes.label: remarketable bond
classes.definition: corporate bond program where the coupon rate on outstanding bonds is periodically reset through an auction process

classes.name: revenue bond
classes.label: revenue bond
classes.definition: municipal bond supported by the revenue from a specific project

classes.name: secured bond
classes.label: secured bond
classes.definition: bond that is backed by collateral, such as a tangible asset or income stream, in addition to a general promise to pay

classes.name: sinking fund amortization terms
classes.label: sinking fund amortization terms
classes.definition: terms for the paydown of principal in a sinking fund type of amortizing security

classes.name: sovereign bond
classes.label: sovereign bond
classes.definition: bond issued by the government of a country

classes.name: sovereign debt instrument
classes.label: sovereign debt instrument
classes.definition: debt security issued by the government of a country

classes.name: special assessment bond
classes.label: special assessment bond
classes.definition: municipal bond used to fund a development project that is payable from the revenues of an assessment (tax) on the community that is intended to benefit from the project

classes.name: special obligation bond
classes.label: special obligation bond
classes.definition: bond secured by a limited revenue source, such as receipts derived from a designated project

classes.name: special tax bond
classes.label: special tax bond
classes.definition: bond secured by revenues derived from designated taxes other than ad valorem taxes

classes.name: step up bond
classes.label: step up bond
classes.definition: bond with a coupon that increases (steps up) while the bond is outstanding

classes.name: stepped coupon terms
classes.label: stepped coupon terms
classes.definition: coupon payment terms for securities with a coupon that increases (steps up) while the bond is outstanding

classes.name: strip bond
classes.label: strip bond
classes.definition: bond that is part of a series of bonds formed by selling each interest payment and the principal amount of a bond as separate zero coupon bonds.

classes.name: tax allocation bond
classes.label: tax allocation bond
classes.definition: bond payable from the incremental increase in tax revenues realized from any increase in property value and other economic activity, often designed to capture the economic benefit resulting from a bond financing

classes.name: treasury bill
classes.label: treasury bill
classes.definition: short-term zero coupon treasury obligation with a maturity ranging from one to twelve months

classes.name: treasury bond
classes.label: treasury bond
classes.definition: long term term coupon bearing treasury obligation issued in terms of 20 years or 30 years that pays interest every six months until they mature

classes.name: treasury inflation-protected security
classes.label: treasury inflation-protected security
classes.definition: variable income bond whose principal is indexed to inflation or deflation and thus changes over the life of the security

classes.name: treasury note
classes.label: treasury note
classes.definition: medium term coupon bearing treasury obligation with original maturity ranging from two to ten years

classes.name: U.K. Government security
classes.label: U.K. Government security
classes.definition: debt instrument issued by HM Treasury and listed on the London Stock Exchange

classes.name: U.S. Treasury security
classes.label: U.S. Treasury security
classes.definition: debt instrument issued by the United States Department of the Treasury that carries a full faith and credit guarantee

classes.name: unlisted bond
classes.label: unlisted bond
classes.definition: bond that is traded over the counter rather than via an exchange or other listing facility

classes.name: unsecured bond
classes.label: unsecured bond
classes.definition: bond that is only secured by the bond issuer's good credit standing

classes.name: variable coupon bond
classes.label: variable coupon bond
classes.definition: bond that has a floating interest rate

classes.name: variable coupon terms
classes.label: variable coupon terms
classes.definition: contractual terms specifying the calculation of the interest rate for a variable coupon bond

classes.name: variable debt principal
classes.label: variable debt principal
classes.definition: principal that is defined in relation to some variable and so varies over time, as principal

classes.name: variable income bond
classes.label: variable income bond
classes.definition: bond whose income may vary over time, because either the coupon rate or principal amount changes in line with an index or schedule over the life of the security

classes.name: variable interest calculation formula
classes.label: variable interest calculation formula
classes.definition: formula for the calculation of variable interest

classes.name: variable interest expression
classes.label: variable interest expression
classes.definition: an expression used to determine a variable interest payment amount

classes.name: variable principal bond
classes.label: variable principal bond
classes.definition: bond whose principal adjusts over time with changes in an index

classes.name: zero coupon bond
classes.label: zero coupon bond
classes.definition: bond issued with a coupon rate of zero and that trades at a deep discount to face value

classes.name: zero coupon terms
classes.label: zero coupon terms
classes.definition: terms for payment of interest on a zero coupon bond

edges.name: has award date
edges.label: has award date
edges.definition: specifies the date on which bonds are awarded to the lead manager or syndicate on negotiated deals, or the date of bidding on competitive deals

edges.name: has call price
edges.label: has call price
edges.definition: indicates the amount of the call on the specified call date, typically the sum of par value and the call premium, as specified in the contract

edges.name: has call rate basis
edges.label: has call rate basis
edges.definition: for each call event on the schedule, indicates whether the rate is expressed as a percentage of par or percentage of percentage of cumulative average value (CAV)

edges.name: has convertible date
edges.label: has convertible date
edges.definition: date on which a bond can be converted into the specified equity security

edges.name: has extraordinary redemption provision
edges.label: has extraordinary redemption provision
edges.definition: relates the redemption provision of a debt instrument to one-time provision that may be exercised by the issuer under certain circumstances

edges.name: has final maturity date
edges.label: has final maturity date
edges.definition: indicates the final payment date of a financial instrument, at which point the principal (and all remaining interest) is due to be paid

edges.name: has first call price
edges.label: has first call price
edges.definition: indicates the amount of the call on the first call date as specified in the call schedule

edges.name: has first coupon payment date
edges.label: has first coupon payment date
edges.definition: specifies the first date on which the issuer or its agent expects or commits to make a coupon payment

edges.name: has first par call date
edges.label: has first par call date
edges.definition: indicates the first date on which the bond may be called at par for redemption

edges.name: has first par call price
edges.label: has first par call price
edges.definition: specifies the amount of the call on the first par call date as specified in the call schedule

edges.name: has first premium call date
edges.label: has first premium call date
edges.definition: indicates the first date on which the bond may be called for redemption at a price above par

edges.name: has first premium call price
edges.label: has first premium call price
edges.definition: specifies the amount of the call on the first call date on which the bond may be called at a price above par as specified in the call schedule

edges.name: has first put date
edges.label: has first put date
edges.definition: indicates the initial date on which the holder may sell the bond to the issuer prior to maturity

edges.name: has first put price
edges.label: has first put price
edges.definition: specifies the initial price at which the holder may sell the bond to the issuer prior to maturity

edges.name: has funding source
edges.label: has funding source
edges.definition: indicates the source of funds for a new issue of municipal securities

edges.name: has last coupon payment date
edges.label: has last coupon payment date
edges.definition: specifies the final date on which the issuer expects to make a final coupon payment

edges.name: has lockout period
edges.label: has lockout period
edges.definition: indicates the period of time for which a callable security cannot be called and only interest coupon payments are received by the security holder

edges.name: has municipal trustee
edges.label: has municipal trustee
edges.definition: specifies the financial institution with trust powers, designated by the issuer, that acts, pursuant to a bond contract, in a fiduciary capacity for the benefit of the bondholders in enforcing the terms of the bond contract

edges.name: has original issue discount amount
edges.label: has original issue discount amount
edges.definition: indicates the difference between the stated redemption price at maturity and the issue price

edges.name: has partial redemption allocation convention
edges.label: has partial redemption allocation convention
edges.definition: indicates the convention used to determine how the redemption is allocated over the set of bond holders

edges.name: has penultimate coupon payment date
edges.label: has penultimate coupon payment date
edges.definition: specifies the last coupon payment prior to maturity

edges.name: has premium amount
edges.label: has premium amount
edges.definition: indicates the premium paid to a bond holder when the bond is called

edges.name: has put date
edges.label: has put date
edges.definition: indicates the date on which a security is subject to redemption by the bond holder

edges.name: has put frequency
edges.label: has put frequency
edges.definition: indicates the recurring window of time in which the put feature can be exercised

edges.name: has redemption amount
edges.label: has redemption amount
edges.definition: indicates the amount of the principal paid with a redemption payment

edges.name: has remarketing agent
edges.label: has remarketing agent
edges.definition: identifies the dealer responsible for reselling to investors securities (such as variable rate demand obligations and other tender option bonds) that have been tendered for purchase by their owner.

edges.name: has reset date offset
edges.label: has reset date offset
edges.definition: indicates the offset from the coupon payment date on which the rate is reset

edges.name: is linked to fallback
edges.label: is linked to fallback
edges.definition: relates an index-linked instrument to a government bond that may be selected by a calculation agent

attributes.name: has ceiling
attributes.label: has ceiling
attributes.definition: indicates the maximum variable interest payment amount

attributes.name: has floor
attributes.label: has floor
attributes.definition: indicates the minimum variable interest payment amount

attributes.name: is bank qualified
attributes.label: is bank qualified
attributes.definition: indicates whether or not a given municipal bond conforms with section 265(b)(3) of the IRS tax code; when purchased by a commercial bank for its portfolio, such designation allows the bank to deduct a portion of the interest cost of carry for the position

attributes.name: is legal opinion available
attributes.label: is legal opinion available
attributes.definition: indicates whether a legal opinion exists for a given municipal bond

attributes.name: is pro-rated
attributes.label: is pro-rated
attributes.definition: indicates whether the coupon is pro rated to the actual number of days in the payment period versus the number of payment periods

attributes.name: super sinker
attributes.label: super sinker
attributes.definition: indicates that the bond has a long-term coupon but short potential short maturity
